summary: 6 backend tests passed, 5 browser checks passed. 1 bug found: sonner Toaster is never mounted in the app, so success/error toasts configured in PredictionDashboard/PartnerSection never render visually.

bugs.criterion: Changing inputs and clicking Calculate yield updates results
bugs.description: toast.success('Scenario recalculated') is called on successful prediction (and toast.error on failure, and in PartnerSection) but no <Toaster /> component from sonner is ever mounted in src/main.tsx or src/App.tsx. The toast calls fire with no visual effect — confirmed by grepping the codebase (no '<Toaster' usage anywhere) and by the browser check failing to find the toast text after clicking Calculate.
bugs.evidence: grep -rn "<Toaster" /app/frontend/src -> no results. src/main.tsx renders QueryClientProvider > BrowserRouter > App with no Toaster. Browser check 'prediction-calculate-updates-results' with a getByText('Scenario recalculated') assertion timed out after 10s (element not found) while the KPI values and results panel updated correctly, proving the request succeeded but the toast never rendered.
bugs.fix_suggestion: Add <Toaster /> from components/ui/sonner.tsx to main.tsx or App.tsx so toast calls actually render.

action_items: Mount <Toaster /> (from src/components/ui/sonner.tsx) in main.tsx/App.tsx so success/error toasts become visible to users — affects PredictionDashboard calculate flow and PartnerSection submit flow.
